text:
Alyssa Parks: Team — VoltCloud asked for our exact spec for cost inputs. We need: hourly (preferred) or daily samples of slots, reserved tiers (1/3/12m), per-slot IDs, spot eviction probability by region, replacement lead time, listing fees, and one invoice sample showing reserve credit line. Can someone draft the request schema?

Chris Kovacs: I'll draft. Quick clarifying Q: should the CSV include historical actuals for the last 30 days or just forecasted availability windows? Finance prefers actuals + forecast if available.

Jun Park: Actuals + forecast is ideal. For historicals include realized_eviction_count and total_spot_hours per slot. Forecast can be eviction_prob and expected_replacement_minutes. Also include rack_pass_through_fee if on-prem.

Priya Nair: Add field for billing_proration_model (e.g., hourly, partial_hour_round_up) — that changes how reserve credits are applied. Also request example invoice lines with JSON and human-readable string.

partner-bot: Proposed CSV schema (sample row) ->
```
slot_id,region,zone,timestamp_iso,gpu_type,reserved_tier_months,price_reserved_usd_per_gpu_hour,price_spot_usd_per_gpu_hour,history_spot_hours,history_eviction_count,eviction_prob_forecast,replacement_lead_minutes,slot_count_in_bucket,listing_fee_usd,rack_pass_through_usd,billing_proration_model,invoice_line_example
vc-slot-721,us-east-1a,A,2026-03-23T14:00:00Z,A100-80GB,12,2.40,0.78,320,1,0.003,60,8,0.10,12.50,hourly,"Invoice lines: Usage: $256.32; Reserve credit: -$120.00; Marketplace fee: $0.80; Net: $137.12"
```

Alyssa Parks: Nice. Can we also ask them to include a small reconciliation snippet showing: (a) how they compute reserve_credit (pro rata on committed hours vs used hours), and (b) when that credit posts (immediate on invoice vs monthly true-up)?

Chris Kovacs: Yep — adding two doc asks: reserve_credit calc pseudocode + timing (billing cadence). Also ask for SLA/eviction SLAs per region (p99 eviction-free window, or expected eviction rate per 1k hours).

Jun Park: For modeling, we want replacement lead distribution (median + 95th pct). If they can provide per-region distro that helps simulate request latency impact.

Priya Nair: One more: if a workload spans reserved and spot (e.g., scaling up into spot), ask for how they show blended usage on invoice. Do they show individual lines per slot or aggregate lines per SKU? That affects traceability.

partner-bot: Added fields to schema and sample invoice JSON suggestion ->
```json
{
  "invoice": [
    {"type":"usage","sku":"A100-80GB","hours":400,"unit_price":2.40,"line_total":960.00},
    {"type":"usage","sku":"A100-80GB-spot","hours":150,"unit_price":0.78,"line_total":117.00},
    {"type":"credit","description":"12mo reserve credit","amount":-120.00},
    {"type":"fee","description":"marketplace listing fee","amount":0.80}
  ],
  "net_due":957.80
}
```

Chris Kovacs: Good. I'll ping VoltCloud partner lead (cc: @partner-bot) and ask for: 1) full CSV for last 30 days at hourly granularity if possible (otherwise daily with 15m sample), 2) the reserve credit pseudocode and timing note, 3) per-region eviction distribution (median, p95) and SLA statement, 4) invoice example both aggregated and per-slot.

partner-bot: Ticket PC-4929 opened: "VoltCloud cost export + reserve credit and invoice examples". Owner: partner-ops. ETA 72 hrs.

Alyssa Parks: Thanks Chris — please also request any marketplace listing deductions (e.g., % take) and whether invoice amounts are tax-inclusive. Without that we can't finalize unit economics.

Chris Kovacs: Added those asks. Will update thread when vendor responds.

Jun Park: I'll align with finance to publish the schema we send them (so we can map fields directly into the cost model).

Priya Nair: Great — if vendor can provide CSV sftp + sample SQL for joining by slot_id that would be perfect.

Alyssa Parks: Closing for now. :white_check_mark:
